reason: The cited evidence (E1) confirms that local chemical ordering exists in some HEAs and has been correlated with mechanical enhancement, but it does not provide specific support for the claims that Al addition or heat treatment induces ordering in CoFeNi, nor does it establish a distinct pinning mechanism separate from solid-solution strengthening. The key premises about the intervention and mechanism are largely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Local chemical ordering (clustered ordering) exists in single-phase HEAs
Such ordering can pin dislocations and enhance strength
Adding Al or heat treatment can induce measurable short-range order in CoFeNi
The strength enhancement from ordering is distinct from standard solid-solution strengthening
The effect diminishes at high temperatures due to thermal disordering
